Stop the Presses
markers: | description = Stop the Presses is a quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Estra Stir in the Lower City or Lens in Rivington or Ettvard Needle in the Baldur's Mouth.

summary: Load this positive article block into the Baldur’s Mouth printing press during Stop the Presses.
